meta.name: antinet-doc-parse
meta.description: 软件开发工程师与数据科学家在构建RAG系统时，当需处理PDF/Word/Excel等多格式复杂文档，用此技能可自动触发三级解析降级，一键输出高置信度结构化Markdown与元数据，免去繁琐清洗，直接夯实企业知识库数据底座！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解析多格式文档为结构化Markdown
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在构建知识库时需要解析各种格式的文档
copy.tagline_en: Parse multi-format documents into structured Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to parse various document formats for your knowledge base

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把 PDF、Word、Excel 等原始文档转成结构化 Markdown 正文和元数据，并给出 0–1 的解析置信度与最终生效的解析器名称。解析器按三级依次降级尝试，三级都失败则标记人工介入、不输出残缺结果。
howto.when: 当密卷房 Worker 收到已通过安全扫描的文件时调用；需要把多格式原始文档转成机器可读文本时也走这里。

用默认全格式解析这个文件，告诉我最终用了哪个解析器
say.note: 三级 fallback 依次尝试后回传生效解析器

say.text: 解析这份 Excel，返回标题、页数、表格数等元数据

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude turns raw PDF/Word/Excel files into structured Markdown plus metadata, and returns a 0–1 parse confidence and the name of the parser that finally ran. Parsers are tried in three tiers with fallback; if all three fail, it flags manual review instead of emitting partial results.
howto.when_en: Invoked when the 密卷房 Worker receives a file that has passed the security scan; also used when multi-format raw documents need to become machine-readable text.

say_en.text: Parse this PDF into structured Markdown and give me the confidence score
say_en.note: Returns body, metadata, confidence and fallback_used

say_en.text: Parse this file with the default all-format whitelist and tell me which parser ran
say_en.note: Tries the three-tier fallback, then reports the parser

say_en.text: Parse this Excel file and return metadata like title, page count, table count
